tools.name: nodeping_get_account
tools.description: The NodePing account the token belongs to (name, status, timezone, next billing date, default probe locations), or a SubAccount with customer_id. GET /accounts.

tools.name: nodeping_list_checks
tools.description: List monitoring checks with label, type, target, interval, enabled state and pass/fail (state 1 = passing, 0 = failing; firstdown = when the current outage began). Filter client-side by status, type or label text. Compact by default; set detail=true for the full (scrubbed) check objects. GET /checks

tools.name: nodeping_get_check
tools.description: One check by id with its full (scrubbed) configuration. Optionally include its latest result and uptime. GET /checks/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_get_check_results
tools.description: Raw results of a check, newest first by default: pass/fail (su), run time (rt, ms), message (m), status text (sc), start (s) and the probe location (l). Use span (hours) or start/end (ms epoch, ISO 8601 or RFC 2822; GMT unless a zone is given) to bound it. GET /results/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_get_check_uptime
tools.description: Uptime percentage of a check per day or month (enabled and down milliseconds plus uptime %), with a total. GET /results/uptime/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_get_check_events
tools.description: Down and disabled events of a check (start, end, message, open) newest first: an incident history. limit=1 returns the most recent event. GET /results/events/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_get_current_events
tools.description: Everything that is down or disabled right now across the account (type, label, since when). The quickest 'what is broken' view. GET /results/current.

tools.name: nodeping_get_check_summary
tools.description: Hourly summary of a check's results: count, min, max and average run time per UTC hour. GET /results/summary/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_list_notifications
tools.description: The alert notifications NodePing sent (who, when, what), for one check or for the whole account, newest first. Contact addresses that are webhook URLs or keys are masked. GET /notifications[/{check_id}].

tools.name: nodeping_list_contacts
tools.description: All notification contacts with their addresses (email, SMS, webhook, Slack, ...). Webhook/Slack/PagerDuty/Pushover addresses are masked. Address ids are what contact groups and checks reference. GET /contacts.

tools.name: nodeping_get_contact
tools.description: One contact by id with its addresses (secret-like addresses masked). GET /contacts?id={id}.

tools.name: nodeping_list_contact_groups
tools.description: Contact groups (name and member address ids), keyed by group id. GET /contactgroups.

tools.name: nodeping_list_schedules
tools.description: Notification schedules (per-weekday time windows a contact is alerted in). GET /schedules.

tools.name: nodeping_get_schedule
tools.description: One notification schedule by name (for example Days or All) with its seven weekday entries. GET /schedules/{name}.

tools.name: nodeping_list_notification_profiles
tools.description: Notification profiles: named sets of contacts/groups with delay and schedule, reusable across checks. GET /notificationprofiles.

tools.name: nodeping_list_maintenance
tools.description: Scheduled and ad-hoc maintenance entries (checks they disable, cron, duration, next run, last runs). GET /maintenance.

tools.name: nodeping_get_maintenance
tools.description: One maintenance entry by id. GET /maintenance/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_get_probe_info
tools.description: NodePing's probe servers (two-letter codes) or regions (nam, lam, eur, eao, wlw): the values a check's run locations use. GET /info/probe[/{code}] or /info/location[/{code}].

tools.name: nodeping_update_check
tools.description: WRITE: change a check's label, description, tags, target, timeout (threshold seconds) or re-checks before alert (sens). Only the fields you pass change. It does not enable the check, create checks or touch billing. PUT /checks/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_mute_check
tools.description: WRITE: mute a check's notifications (the check keeps running and recording) until a time or indefinitely, or unmute it. mute_until is a future time in ms since the epoch; omit it with mute=true to mute until unmuted. PUT /checks/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_disable_check
tools.description: WRITE: stop a check from running (enabled=false); its history is kept. Re-enabling is done in the NodePing app (it changes the number of billed checks). PUT /checks/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_create_adhoc_maintenance
tools.description: WRITE: create a one-off maintenance window that disables the listed checks for duration_minutes and re-enables them afterwards (no alerts meanwhile). Created inactive unless start_now=true, which starts it immediately. POST /maintenance/ad-hoc.

tools.name: nodeping_delete_maintenance
tools.description: WRITE (destructive): remove a maintenance entry. DELETE /maintenance/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_create_contact_group
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact group from existing contact address ids. POST /contactgroups.

tools.name: nodeping_update_contact_group
tools.description: WRITE: rename a contact group and/or replace its member list (send the FULL list; omitted members are removed). PUT /contactgroups/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_delete_contact_group
tools.description: WRITE (destructive): delete a contact group. Checks that notify the group lose that notification target. DELETE /contactgroups/{id}.

tools.name: nodeping_put_schedule
tools.description: WRITE: create or update a notification schedule. NodePing stores all seven weekdays at once, so for an existing schedule the weekdays you pass are merged into its current ones; a new schedule needs all seven. Per weekday: time1/time2 window (24h), exclude to invert it, disabled for no alerts, allday

tools.name: nodeping_delete_schedule
tools.description: WRITE (destructive): delete a notification schedule by name. DELETE /schedules/{name}.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "nodeping_get_contact" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: One contact by id with its addresses (secret-like addresses masked). GET /contacts?id={id}.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "nodeping_get_probe_info" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nodeping_get_check_results, nodeping_get_check_events, nodeping_list_notifications, nodeping_list_contacts, nodeping_list_schedules, nodeping_get_schedule, nodeping_list_notification_profiles, nodeping_mute_check, nodeping_put_schedule · Private data: nodeping_get_account, nodeping_list_notifications, nodeping_list_contacts, nodeping_get_contact, nodeping_list_contact_groups, nodeping_list_schedules, nodeping_list_notification_profiles, nodeping_create_contact_group, nodeping_update_contact_group, nodeping_delete_contact_group · Public sink: nodeping_list_notifications, nodeping_list_contacts, nodeping_create_adhoc_maintenance, nodeping_create_contact_group, nodeping_update_contact_group, nodeping_delete_contact_group · Destructive: nodeping_get_check_results, nodeping_get_check_summary, nodeping_list_maintenance, nodeping_get_probe_info, nodeping_delete_maintenance, nodeping_delete_contact_group, nodeping_delete_schedule.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nodeping_get_check_results, nodeping_get_check_events, nodeping_list_notifications, nodeping_list_contacts, nodeping_list_schedules, nodeping_get_schedule, nodeping_list_notification_profiles, nodeping_mute_check, nodeping_put_schedule · Private data: nodeping_get_account, nodeping_list_notifications, nodeping_list_contacts, nodeping_get_contact, nodeping_list_contact_groups, nodeping_list_schedules, nodeping_list_notification_profiles, nodeping_create_contact_group, nodeping_update_contact_group, nodeping_delete_contact_group · Public sink: nodeping_list_notifications, nodeping_list_contacts, nodeping_create_adhoc_maintenance, nodeping_create_contact_group, nodeping_update_contact_group, nodeping_delete_contact_group · Destructive: nodeping_get_check_results, nodeping_get_check_summary, nodeping_list_maintenance, nodeping_get_probe_info, nodeping_delete_maintenance, nodeping_delete_contact_group, nodeping_delete_schedule

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
